verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack describes a supervised or copilot mode where the agent drafts replies and a human approves them before they reach the customer. The adjacent capabilities do not deliver that: offline simulations before deployment, response guardrails that block, rewrite or escalate, human handoff when the AI can't resolve, and limiting deployment to trained topics. Draft-for-approval is a fair axis for an AI customer-support agent, so this is 'none' rather than 'na'.
